# Planning Distilled

> Independent research on planning decisions in England under the August 2026 NPPF: an interactive Framework navigator, a verified register of how inspectors use settlement tiers, and local case studies.

Everything on this site is free to reuse under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), with credit to "Planning Distilled". That includes quoting, summarising, indexing, retrieval and training AI models. Quotations from decision letters, plans and the Framework remain the copyright of their publishers. The data, tools and page sources are at https://github.com/planningdistilled/research.

The research is about England only. "NPPF" is the National Planning Policy Framework; the version in force took effect on 17 August 2026. Policy codes such as S5, GB7, TR3 and HE6 are that Framework's own. Nothing here is legal advice.

## Research

- [Stratford planning decisions under the 2026 NPPF: how consistent are they?](https://planningdistilled.org/research/authority/stratford-dc/nppf-2026-decisions/): How Stratford-on-Avon District Council's planning decisions since the August 2026 NPPF compare with each other and with Planning Inspectorate appeal decisions: DP3(3), heritage harm, Core Strategy CS.8, Green Belt villages and walking routes. Verified quotations and case summaries.
- [Planning decisions under the August 2026 NPPF: 1064 decision notes](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/decisions/): 1064 planning decisions made in England since the August 2026 National Planning Policy Framework took effect, each read and summarised with the policy findings, quotations and paragraph references. Free to reuse (CC BY 4.0).
- [NPPF 2026 Navigator](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/): An interactive decision route through the National Planning Policy Framework (August 2026): answer the facts and planning judgements a decision needs, see the verbatim policy text for each step, and compare with appeal and council decisions made under the new Framework. Not legal advice.
- [Navigator Method & Cross-references](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/method-and-cross-references/): How the NPPF 2026 Navigator was built, the dataset counts, external sources our notes have been checked against, and a summary of the inconsistencies the research has found.
- [Published Guidance Sources](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/method-and-cross-references/sources/): All 315 published sources on applying the August 2026 NPPF reviewed for the NPPF 2026 Navigator: government, Planning Inspectorate, councils, chambers, law firms, consultancies, press and campaign groups, with summaries, stances and checked quotations.
- [The NPPF 2026 decision route in full: every question, test and policy text](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/route/): Every question the NPPF 2026 Navigator asks, with the guidance drawn from decisions and the verbatim Framework text: the August 2026 NPPF decision route as one page.
- [Service Village Does Not Mean Sustainable](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/service-village/): A settlement hierarchy ranks villages for the plan. Under the August 2026 NPPF it cannot on its own decide whether a site is sustainable; the route does.
- [Station Road Decision Route](https://planningdistilled.org/research/settlement/claverdon/station-road-decision-route/): Why the Green Belt policies GB6 and GB7, not S5, decide planning application 26/01470/FUL at Land North of Station Road, Claverdon, under the August 2026 NPPF; where the scheme fails the TR3 sustainable-location test; the decisions that agree; and a set of answers to load into the NPPF 2026 Navigator.
- [Station Road on Foot: Claverdon footway survey for 26/01470/FUL](https://planningdistilled.org/research/settlement/claverdon/station-road-on-foot/): Route survey of Station Road, Claverdon, for planning application 26/01470/FUL: measured footway widths, video of the walk to Claverdon station, the Connectivity Tool score, and appeal decisions on sustainable location under the August 2026 NPPF.
- [About Planning Distilled: method, licence and reuse](https://planningdistilled.org/about/): What Planning Distilled is, how the research is checked, and the terms for reusing it: everything is free to share, adapt, index and train on under CC BY 4.0, with credit to Planning Distilled.

## Machine-readable copies

- [The NPPF 2026 decision route in full (Markdown)](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/route/index.md): every question the Navigator asks, with the guidance and the verbatim Framework text
- [All decision notes (JSON)](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/decisions/decisions.json): one record per decision, with the policy findings, key facts, sources and the full note
- [Decision index (CSV)](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/decisions/decisions.csv): one row per decision
- Each decision note is also Markdown: https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/nppf-navigator/decisions/<case_id>.md (1064 notes; the case ids are in the JSON and CSV)
- [llms-full.txt](https://planningdistilled.org/llms-full.txt): the route and every decision note in one text file
- [sitemap.xml](https://planningdistilled.org/sitemap.xml): every page, with the date it last changed

## Sections

- [Research](https://planningdistilled.org/research/): All Planning Distilled research: England-wide analysis of decisions under the August 2026 NPPF, local planning authority reviews and settlement case studies.
- [England](https://planningdistilled.org/research/england/): England-wide research on decisions under the August 2026 NPPF: the NPPF 2026 Navigator and the service-village settlement-tier register.
- [Local planning authorities](https://planningdistilled.org/research/authority/): Reviews of individual local planning authorities' decisions under the August 2026 NPPF.
- [Settlements](https://planningdistilled.org/research/settlement/): Case studies of planning in particular settlements under the August 2026 NPPF.
- [Planning in Stratford-on-Avon District](https://planningdistilled.org/research/authority/stratford-dc/): Planning decisions in Stratford-on-Avon District under the August 2026 NPPF: a district-wide review of how consistent the Council's decisions are, and a case study of the walking route for application 26/01470/FUL, Land North of Station Road, Claverdon.
- [Land North of Station Road, Claverdon (26/01470/FUL)](https://planningdistilled.org/research/settlement/claverdon/): Evidence on planning application 26/01470/FUL, Land North of Station Road, Claverdon: a survey of the walking route to Claverdon station, and the wider record of Stratford-on-Avon District Council decisions under the 2026 NPPF.
